join hortbot 999 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set mode
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Mode is set to everyone.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set mode what
send hortbot #foobar [HB] what is not a valid mode.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set mode everyone
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Mode is already set to everyone.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set mode 2
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Mode is already set to everyone.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command adda test Hi there!
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'test' added, restricted to everyone and above.


handle hortbot foobar/1 user2/2 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Hi there!


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set mode subs
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Mode set to subscriber.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set mode 3
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Mode is already set to subscriber.

handle hortbot foobar/1 user2/2 :!test
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 user2/2 access=subscriber :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Hi there!

handle hortbot foobar/1 user2/2 access=moderator :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Hi there!

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Hi there!

handle hortbot foobar/1 user2/2 access=admin :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Hi there!


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set mode mods
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Mode set to moderator.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set mode 1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Mode is already set to moderator.

handle hortbot foobar/1 user2/2 :!test
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 user2/2 access=subscriber :!test
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 user2/2 access=moderator :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Hi there!

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Hi there!

handle hortbot foobar/1 user2/2 access=admin :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Hi there!


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set mode owner
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Mode set to broadcaster.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set mode 0
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Mode is already set to broadcaster.

handle hortbot foobar/1 user2/2 :!test
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 user2/2 access=subscriber :!test
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 user2/2 access=moderator :!test
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Hi there!

handle hortbot foobar/1 user2/2 access=admin :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Hi there!
